features.title: Hard crash and hang fixes that affect 4.3 today
features.description: Merged from cave-carver-threadsafety-fix, cloud-rain-deadlock-fix, bugfixes-for-4-3 item 1 and the crash parts of the structure and bugfix bundles. (1) EncasedFireJetBlock declares its own STATE property that is not in the block's state definition, so a redstone update calls state.getValue(STATE) and throws (8a8497a64; checked in 4.3 EncasedFireJetBlock lines 14/22). (2) TFCavesCarver uses one shared 'RandomSource rand = RandomSource.create()' (4.3 line 35) inside carveBlock while carvers run in parallel, which can trip ThreadingDetector; 4.8 uses ctx.randomState().oreRandom().at(pos). (3) ASMHooks.cloud (cloud.js on Level#isRainingAt) calls getBlockState up to N blocks above any position, so rain checks during mob spawning or lightning can load chunks and deadlock; 4.8 BlockHooks adds a hasChunkAt guard and reads the chunk directly. (4) TFArrow null-shooter crash (#1958). (5) Final Castle / Troll Cave garden crash on load: TFStructureComponentOld.isBoundingBoxOutsideBiomes uses world.getBiome(pos.set(x,0,z)), which 905123c0f changes to getUncachedNoiseBiome. (6) TFMaze NPE when pillar, head or door states are null (#2335). (7) PinchBeetle crash.
features.reason: Each fix is one to fifteen lines on code that is unchanged in 4.3, and all were checked in the 4.3 tree. The cloud guard goes into 4.3's ASMHooks.cloud; the cloud.js coremod stays as it is. Not included: AvoidLandmarkModifier #2554. 4.3 still uses the legacy grid centre there, not StructureStart references, so that crash cannot happen in 4.3; it belongs to avoid-landmark-modifier-v2.

features.title: Worldgen concurrency and determinism fixes
features.description: Merged from worldgen-concurrency-fixes, biome-layer-concurrency, worldgen-thread-safety and red-canopy-mushroom-variants. Changes: LazyArea moves to a ConcurrentHashMap with an eviction queue, and LazyAreaContext is split into a per-call RandomContext passed through AreaTransformer*.applyPixel. KeyBiomesLayer drops its static RANDOM (4.3 line 32). TFMaze (hedge maze, labyrinth, dark tower) and StrongholdPieceWeight state become per-instance. CanopyMushroomFeature's shared 'bugsLeft' field (4.3 line 22) is replaced by a stateless WeightedListFeature with four red-mushroom shapes. The Final Castle mural is generated once and serialized instead of being mutated in postProcess. FoliageColorHandler uses a concurrent weak map cleared on level leave (#2361). possibleBiomes are sorted, and the terrain column lookup is O(1).
features.reason: Plain Java with no 1.21 API, which supports the 'easy' rating some sweeps gave. It is rated medium because the applyPixel signature change touches about 19 layer classes and the LCG sequence must stay byte-identical. KeyBiomesLayer reseeds its Random on every call, so a local Random gives identical output and the existing biome map does not shift. Check this with a fixed-seed biome dump before and after. The 4.3 path for FoliageColorHandler is twilightforest/FoliageColorHandler.java. Matters on this pack because it runs Embeddium client meshing and parallel server chunk generation.
features.savegame_impact: none (biome/layer output identical if RNG order is preserved; adds configured_feature ids only)

features.title: Worldgen and tick performance fixes (thorns, clouds, config caching)
features.description: Merged from thorns-perf-fix and worldgen-perf-fixes. ThornFeature stops calling WorldUtil.getBaseHeight (a full noise-column evaluation) for every thorn block; it uses chunk heightmaps when hasChunk is true (7d9de6404, b23b8fc38). ChunkBlanketingModifier gets a biome_lock HolderSet instead of a registry lookup for every column, and the placed thorns lose their redundant BiomeFilter. The cloud precipitation check uses LevelChunk with a cached config (c50ef588a, #1997). Hot-path ForgeConfigSpec.get() calls are cached (84ccdeec6, 333678333, a2b9fa06b). The ControlledSpawnsCache diff is applied on top of 4.3's existing class.
features.reason: Small logic changes on vanilla APIs that already exist in 4.3. Codecs stay plain Codec.

features.title: Charm of Life/Keeping and casket: multiplayer-safe state, PlayerRevive/Cosmetic Armor compat, totem animation
features.description: Merged from charm-system-rework, charm-fixes-totem-animation, charm-of-keeping-rewrite, charm-keeping-death-compat, charm-activation-animation, charm-totem-animation and cosmetic-armor-compat. In 4.3, CharmEvents keeps 'charmUsed' and 'casketExpiration' in static fields shared by all players, and the keep path builds 'new Inventory(null)', which crashes (#2155); both were checked in 4.3. 4.8 stores the state in per-player persistent NBT. applyCharmOfLife runs at HIGHEST priority and respects canceled deaths; Keeping and casket run at HIGH (#2013 PlayerRevive). A keeping charm is consumed only if the slots it covers hold items. One casket is kept, and charms stack again after use. CosmeticArmorCompat cancels CosArmorDeathDrops while a keeping charm is active. SpawnCharmPacket animates the charm client-side, with an optional vanilla totem pop (client config totemCharmAnimation).
features.reason: Pure event and NBT logic on the same CharmEvents structure 4.3 has. The packet goes on the SimpleChannel, and casket damage uses 4.3's BREAKAGE blockstate and NBT instead of DataComponents.BLOCK_STATE. Cosmetic Armor Reworked is in the pack (local-mods), so the compat hook is live. The skull-chest fallback stays in keepsake-casket-skull-chest.

features.title: Boss loot-chest, AI and multipart sync fixes
features.description: Merged from boss-loot-chest-fixes, boss-misc-bugfixes, minor-boss-fixes and multipart-sync-fix. Loot chest: IBossLootBuffer copies overflow from stacks.subList(28,…) instead of CONTAINER_SIZE 27, which deletes one stack (#2556; checked at 4.3 line 55). If the chest cannot be placed it now searches upward or pops the items instead of losing them (#2057). It respects doMobLoot and plays the sound once (#2072). Boss AI: Alpha Yeti rampages only when a hit landed (#2054); Ur-Ghast fireballs spawn 2 blocks higher (#2092); dying Naga segments no longer deal damage (#1921); Minoshroom gets a proper AXING damage source; LichPopMobsGoal no longer pops bosses (LICH_POPPABLES excludes c:bosses). Multipart sync: UpdateTFMultipartPacket is keyed by part entity id. 4.3 matches parts by index, which desyncs when the client and server part lists differ (checked).
features.reason: Self-contained diffs on code that 4.3 has in the same shape. The packet stays FriendlyByteBuf-based.

features.title: Per-player potion flask advancement tracking
features.description: Merged from flask-tracking-per-player and flask-advancement-tracking. 4.3 BrittleFlaskItem tracks doses for 'Full Mettle Alchemist' in static fields (lastUsedPotion, timesUsed, advancementWindow, seconds; checked) ticked from TFTickHandler, so the state is shared by every player on the server. 4.8 stores it per player and passes elapsed seconds to drink_from_flask.
features.reason: A player capability or persistent NBT replaces the attachment. The criterion stays a 1.20.1 SimpleCriterionTrigger with JSON deserialization.

features.title: Client performance and crash fixes (ISTER, armor models, aurora shader, PatchModel)
features.description: Merged from client-render-perf-fixes, client-render-bugfixes and client-render-fixes. ISTER creates a new BlockEntity every frame for every EntityBlock item (4.3 ISTER line 170). Arctic, Fiery, Knightmetal, Phantom and Yeti armor call models.bakeLayer on every getHumanoidArmorModel; they now cache and reset on reload. aurora.fsh indexes a vec3 dynamically (cuboct[int(hash/16.0)], checked), which crashes Intel Iris Xe drivers. The aurora biome check is cached as holders instead of scanning the registry every tick. PatchModel races with Embeddium chunk meshing (6e383aa2e, 52455a248). GiantBlockModel quads get shade=true. The EntityRenderingUtil map is cleared on screen close (#2488). Head hiding moves to RenderLivingEvent.Pre (#2267).
features.reason: All the affected code was checked in 4.3, and the IClientItemExtensions API is the same on Forge 47. The shader fix could even ship as a resource-pack override. Embeddium 0.3.31 is in the pack, so the PatchModel race is real here.

features.title: Twilight portal teleporter safety and correctness
features.description: Merged from tf-teleporter-safety, teleporter-safety-fixes, both portal-teleporter-fixes entries, teleporter-safety-rework and new-player-spawn-fix. Portals no longer destroy bedrock or FEATURES_CANNOT_REPLACE blocks, and the dirt under a portal only replaces DIRT, REPLACEABLE or AIR blocks (#2046). Existing portals below y=0 are found; 4.3 stops at 'getY() >= 0' (checked). The fallback uses the scaled coordinates instead of ITeleporter.super (#1968, checked). The arrival spot is a random safe border block instead of portalBorder[0] (#2014, checked). There is a 'portal in air' tier, structure overlap is checked through chunk references, and biome cells are prechecked with DiagonalSpiralIterator. NoReturnTeleporter picks a safe spot (#1984). Players banished by newPlayersSpawnInTF land on MOTION_BLOCKING_NO_LEAVES (6da868af5). TeleporterCache SavedData is optional.
features.reason: Sweeps disagreed between easy and medium. Medium: the first fix set (state at 1b1b4e939) is near drop-in for 4.3's ITeleporter, but the 2025 rework (2758b36b6..f5ee38e28) is written against the 1.21 DimensionTransition portal API and must be re-applied method by method. Keep 4.3's link cache and banish NBT flag.

features.title: Landmark structure and feature-template bugfixes
features.description: Merged from structure-bugfixes-misc, structure-template-fixes and structure-generation-bugfixes (non-stronghold parts). Fixes: Labyrinth floor and ceiling holes (#1937); incomplete Hedge Maze (#2035), maze chest facing (#2024), and canopy trees at maze exits (#2075); Quest Grove not placing its dropper or Questing Ram; Dark Tower entrance (#2049); IceTowerStairs bounding box (#2503); Hydra Lair floor; Yeti Cave drain and lattice height; stone circles made deeper (#1993); stone spikes in invalid places; druid hut, well and fancy well templates placed with flag 20, which left basement chests empty (#2270, now UPDATE_CLIENTS); wells generating on the dark-forest canopy; deepslate blobs in the stronghold foundry.

Template NBTs that were re-saved at DataVersion 3955 should get their edits replayed on the 4.3 templates rather than be copied.

features.title: Knight Stronghold fixes (persisted start Y #2138, entrances, ruins, bounding boxes)
features.description: Merged from knight-stronghold-fixes, stronghold-ruins-fix and the stronghold part of structure-generation-bugfixes. KnightStructureStart stores knight_y and clips the start bounding box at the surface, replacing the TFTickHandler 'gross hack' (#2138); before this, protection and spawning changed after a restart. Entrances can be underground again (SEALEVEL-2), access chambers are no longer force-buried, and the foundry and dead-end boxes are fixed. Ruins can be taller than 1 block via SimpleRandomBlockSelector, with StrongholdStones, KnightStones, TowerwoodProcessor and others unified in structures/selectors/.

features.savegame_impact: none (adds optional knight_y to start NBT)

features.title: Tree and root generation fixes
features.description: Merged from tree-feature-bugfixes, tree-roots-and-tree-fixes and tree-root-generation-fixes. Fixes: TreeRootsDecorator gains rootPenetrability and y_offset, so roots and Time Tree growth no longer break bedrock or other non-replaceable blocks (d0e183242, 42c15869c), and roots no longer generate too high (cb457c9cc); Time Tree bottom layer (4fe90ee05); Mining and Time tree cores placed only where replaceable (#2209); hollow-tree roots respect canRootGrowIn (#2076); DangleFromTreeDecorator rope length off by one (#2061, checked in 4.3); LargeWinterTree could never generate (#2176); mangrove roots start 1 block lower (#2185); canopy mushrooms no longer overwrite tower blocks (46a06ef13); time and dark canopy trees may replace flowers.
features.reason: Logic-only on shared classes. rootPenetrability is a required codec field, so make it optionalFieldOf with a default or regenerate every tree configured_feature JSON. canSustainPlant uses the Forge boolean form.

features.title: Stalactite and stalagmite (BlockSpikeFeature) fixes
features.description: Ore selection now uses a WeightedRandomList; 4.3's 'highest weight' roll is biased. Hollow-hill stalagmites no longer poke through topsoil (heightmap-2 clearance plus forcedMaxHeight). Spikes no longer start on liquids or bedrock (FeatureLogic.isBlockNotOk). A new tag supports_stalagmites (deadrock, packed ice) is added. Yeti cave stalagmite elevation is fixed.
features.reason: Vanilla APIs, and the fixes can be applied against 4.3's map-based stalactite config. The registry-format change is speleothem-config-datadriven.

features.title: Mob, projectile and damage-source fixes
features.description: Merged from goblin-knight-fixes, swarm-spider-spawn-fix, projectile-misc-fixes, damage-source-attacker-fix and the entity parts of misc-gameplay-bugfixes and bugfix-bundle. Fixes: Upper Goblin Knights did not attack while riding (#1910) and spawn at Y+1 (#2234). Swarm spiders' SpawnMore self-replication is removed (#2311); the swarm comes from getMaxSpawnClusterSize and the druid jockey chance is 1/200. EntityExcludedDamageSource dropped attackers, which broke kill credit, shields and knockback. Hydra mortar, lich bolt and bomb, and moonworm now use indirect sources (#2056). Seeker and Ice arrows copy the parent arrow (#2399, via BowItem#customArrow). Lifedrain no longer shatters bosses (#2122). Transformation powder ignores tamed mobs and drops saddles (#2157). Ghastlings are fireproof. Hedge damage is reliable and skips druid jockeys.
features.reason: Small diffs on 4.3 code; the buggy versions were checked (SwarmSpider.spawnAnother, the 4.3 util/EntityExcludedDamageSource constructor, HydraMortar getEntityDamageSource). The 1.21 AbstractArrow weapon-stack constructor becomes BowItem#customArrow.

features.description: Merged from the non-crash part of bugfixes-for-4-3, enchantment-balance-fixes, fiery-tool-smelting-xp, the item parts of gameplay-balance-tweaks and the block parts of misc-gameplay-bugfixes. Fixes: Carminite Reactor drops itself in its final explosion (023e14efc); other mods can make the glass sword unbreakable; scepters use charges in creative (#2039); the trophy pedestal needs progress_lich in creative (#2037); Carminite Builder (#1948); Chill Aura and Fire React are made exclusive with Thorns, cost 2 durability, and can no longer go on Fiery or Yeti armor (#1945, #2040); Tri-bow side arrows; forceSolidOn for castle doors, reappearing blocks and TF fence gates (#2251, #2253); fallen leaves acting solid (#2158); skull candle flame offsets (#1936); encased fire jet light (#2285); fiery tools award smelting XP; ice tools repairable (#1996); shear drops use ToolActions.SHEARS_DIG; huge lily pad PlantType.WATER (#2038); Experiment 115 (#2116); crumble horn durability (#2236); ore magnet and ancient debris (#1981); mining_tree_excluded tag (#2202); huge_stalk flammable (#2336); stronghold shield facing (#1930).

Fixes: Ur-Ghast tentacle UVs (texOffs per iteration; the 4.3 texOffs(0,3)/(0,9) bug was checked); dazed Naga offset (#2352); Block and Chain goblin culling, link spacing and return facing; crumble horn particles; Yeti armor chest box; Snow Queen crown parented to the head (#2394); leaf rune particle colour and gravity; hollow log tint and sounds; fiddlehead tint; firefly model legs and emissive glow; giant block outline jitter; magic map icons drawn below the player marker (in maprendercontext.js on 4.3); fire jet and smoker textures.

features.title: Loot table fixes applicable to 4.3

features.title: Drop seed.js coremod in favour of WorldUtil.getOverworldSeed()
features.description: 0695a6e84 removes the WorldOptions.<init> coremod. LegacyLandmarkPlacements, KeyBiomesLayer and LazyAreaContext read the seed through ServerLifecycleHooks instead.

features.savegame_impact: none if the seed value is identical (otherwise the landmark grid shifts and the TF dimension needs a reset)

features.title: TF Beardifier bridge + CustomDensitySource + structure density functions
features.description: Merged from custom-density-terraforming and structure-terrain-density-functions. In 4.8 a structure that implements CustomDensitySource returns a DensityFunction per chunk, which is added to the Beardifier, and pieces control their own beard through NeoForge PieceBeardifierModifier. The density types are BoxDensityFunction, AbsoluteDifferenceFunction (coord_min/coord_max), HollowHillFunction, TanhHillFunction, FocusedDensityFunction and SqrtDensityFunction. UtilityPiece (TFUtilityPiece) exists only for beard shape, protection and feature allowance. On 4.3: ChunkGeneratorTwilight.doFill is TF's own copy of fillFromNoise and never evaluates a Beardifier (line 312 is a commented-out TODO). The port therefore builds a TFBeardifier inside doFill: a copy of the vanilla Beardifier.forStructuresInChunk logic, plus WorldgenHooks.gatherCustomTerrain, plus a TF IPieceBeardifierModifier interface. Its compute() result, scaled to the warp-noise range, is added to noiseval before generateBaseState.
features.reason: Sweeps rated this hard. Re-rated medium after checking the 4.3 code: because TF owns the TF dimension's fill loop, none of the three tf-asm Beardifier transformers or the NeoForge PieceBeardifierModifier is needed; it is ordinary Java inside doFill (pass StructureManager into it). The density classes port as Codec + KeyDispatchDataCodec on Registries.DENSITY_FUNCTION_TYPE. The real work is tuning the scale factor, because the 1.16-style warp noise is unnormalized. Prerequisite for the Lich Tower yard, Fallen Trunk mounds and Courtyard/Hedge Maze clearing.
features.savegame_impact: changes worldgen for new chunks: 4.3 structures that already declare terrain_adaptation start bearding in the TF dimension, so a structure that straddles old and new chunks can show a seam; no saved-data break

features.title: TF jigsaw pieces and data-driven template pools
features.description: TwilightJigsawPiece (piece type TFJigsawTemplate) grows templates recursively without collisions. It supports vertical junctions, the jigsaw's selection_priority, per-piece terrain_adaptation, processors and weighted randomized processors (rolled once and serialized), height_adjustment, ignore_world_waterlog, pool_aliases and marker handlers. JigsawUtil, JigsawPlaceContext and JigsawRecord are the helpers. Pools come from data/<ns>/twilight/template_definition/** (StructureTemplateDefinitions, TemplatePoolInstance, CodecResourceReloadListener), so modpacks can add or replace templates by datapack. The 1,331 lines of code are shared by the Lich Tower, Camp, Final Castle hooks and the Courtyard spawner.
features.reason: Uses only vanilla StructureTemplate, JigsawBlock and StructurePiece APIs. Rewrites are needed for StructurePlaceSettings.setLiquidSettings(IGNORE_WATERLOGGING), a 1.21 API (replace with a processor that strips waterlogged), SinglePoolElement.sortBySelectionPriority (1.20.3+, reimplement), Codec.withAlternative (use ExtraCodecs.withAlternative), Beanification, and Java 21 getFirst/getLast calls. The template_definition JSONs copy over unchanged.

features.title: Data-driven template marker handlers
features.description: Merged from template-marker-handlers and the marker part of structure-template-definitions. Adds the registries template_marker_handler_type (static) and template_marker_handler and template_marker_handler_list (datapack). They turn structure-block DATA markers into content. Handler types: rotation, handler_switch, block_placement, loot (a chest, barrel or pot with a loot table), drying_rack (an item rolled from loot), painting (random #minecraft:placeable) and template. camp_marker_handlers is the first list that uses them.
features.reason: Uses DataPackRegistryEvent.NewRegistry on Forge 47. The loot key becomes a ResourceLocation. The 1.20.1 painting registry is static, but the #minecraft:placeable tag exists. 1.20.1 decorated pots have no inventory, so loot markers on pots must target barrels.

features.title: New structure processors (infest, soft replace, spawner, update marking, vertical decay, multiswizzle)
features.description: Merged from structure-processors-48 and structure-processors-new. Adds the processors infest_blocks, soft_replace (only air or replaceable), spawner_processor (weighted SpawnData, delay, range, entity_width_max), update_marking (fixes fence and bar connections), vertical_decay and wood_multiswizzle. Includes fixes to BoxCutting, SmartGrass, StateTransfiguring, TargetedRot and WoodPaletteSwizzle.
features.reason: Plain StructureProcessor subclasses. MapCodec becomes Codec, and SpawnData drops the 1.21 equipment argument. Sweeps disagreed between easy and medium; easy, because nothing outside the codecs changes.

features.title: avoid_landmark_grid placement for minor structures
features.description: A RandomSpreadStructurePlacement that rejects chunks within about 80 blocks of a TF landmark-grid centre. It accepts an avoid_additional_structures map (structure set to chunk radius) plus an exclusion_zone. Used by camp, fallen_trunk and hollow_tree. Includes #2058.
features.reason: Its only TF dependency is LegacyLandmarkPlacements (checked; 4.3 has it at util/LegacyLandmarkPlacements.java), so it does not need the chunkgen overhaul. Only the codec type changes.

features.title: Multi-sample weighted terrain height for structure placement
features.description: New WorldUtil.adjustForTerrain overloads sample a grid of WORLD_SURFACE_WG heights across the footprint and take a high-biased weighted average. Used by Hedge Maze (radius 24), Naga Courtyard (radius 40, +2), Lich Tower, Fallen Trunk and Camp.
features.reason: Checked: 4.3's DecorationClearance.adjustForTerrain samples only the centre column, clamped to sea level +1..+7. That is the 'only start-chunk centre checked' pitfall documented in AGENTS.md. The sampler is self-contained, but the radii were tuned for 4.8 terrain and must be re-tuned against 4.3's warp terrain.

features.title: no_structure placement modifier v2 (piece-accurate clearance)
features.description: Merged from avoid-landmark-modifier-v2 and feature-clearance-modifier. twilightforest:no_structure reads chunk.getAllReferences(), skips invalid starts (the #2554 isValid check is needed only in this version), and measures clearance per piece bounding box when the radius is 0 or less. It adds occupies_vegetation, additional_clearance, a structures_allowed HolderSet, and allow_biome_vegetation in decoration_clearance. Placement order fixes: plant_roots, wood_roots and vanilla_roots are checked after in_square; torch_berries get in_square; druid_hut clearance is 16.
features.reason: StructureStart.isValid and getAllReferences exist in 1.20.1. Needs DecorationClearance.isGrassDecoAllowed and UtilityPiece.allowFeatures. Either regenerate about 60 placed-feature JSONs or keep 4.3's 'value' codec wrapper.

features.title: 'progression' and 'landmark' wrapper structure types
features.description: Merged from progression-wrapped-structure and the wrapper part of landmark-placement-rework. The datapack structure types twilightforest:progression and twilightforest:landmark wrap any structure, for example a vanilla or other-mod jigsaw structure from a datapack, with TF advancement locking and hints or with landmark decoration clearance.
features.reason: 4.3 already has ProgressionStructure and its progressionCodec. Needs an AT on Structure.findGenerationPoint (present in the 4.8 accesstransformer.cfg) and dropping the structure_icon field. Useful for gating the pack's own datapack structures behind TF progression.

features.title: Structure debug commands (display_pieces, count_loot, generator_radius, map_locator)
features.description: Merged from both structure-debug-commands entries. /tf structure_util display_pieces, clear_display, count_loot, count_template and generator_radius visualise piece bounding boxes with Display entities and count loot or templates. /tf map_locator gives a locator map.
features.reason: Display entities exist since 1.19.4. Register the commands statically. count_template only works after twilight-jigsaw-framework. Port this early, because it is the main tool for checking the structure ports.

features.title: Multiplayer-inclusive boss fights (health and loot scaling, group credit)
features.description: Merged from three multiplayer-boss-scaling entries. New config multiplayerFightAdjuster: NONE, MORE_LOOT, MORE_HEALTH or MORE_LOOT_AND_HEALTH. Entities in #twilightforest:multiplayer_inclusive_entities gain +20/40/60 max HP (easy/normal/hard) per extra player within 32 blocks at spawn. Every player who damages the boss is recorded and gets the hurt_boss advancement trigger. The loot function multiplayer_addition and number provider multiplayer_rolls add drops per extra participant. progress_knights no longer requires hurt_boss.
features.reason: Sweeps disagreed on whether this needs BaseTFBoss. Checked: 4.8 applies it in EntityEvents through the entity tag, not in BaseTFBoss, so it has no dependency. Needed on 4.3: a mob capability for participants, MobSpawnEvent.FinalizeSpawn, the loot types rewritten with 1.20.1 Gson Serializers, and the boss loot JSONs under loot_tables/entities edited. High value on this multiplayer server.
features.savegame_impact: new ids only; the health bonus applies to new spawns

features.title: BaseTFBoss common base and client-synced death animations
features.description: Merged from boss-base-class-refactor and boss-death-time-sync. Abstract BaseTFBoss (Monster + IBossLootBuffer + EnforcedHomePoint) collects the home point, peaceful despawn back to spawner, loot-chest buffer, conquered marking and boss bar code that 4.3 copies into each boss. Naga, Lich, Minoshroom, Hydra, KnightPhantom, UrGhast, AlphaYeti, SnowQueen and PlateauBoss extend it; Minoshroom no longer extends Minotaur, and UrGhast no longer extends CarminiteGhastguard. Death animations run client-side in tickDeathAnimation, and UpdateDeathTimePacket syncs deathTime on startSeenByPlayer.
features.reason: Pure Java, but it touches every boss class. Keep the 4.3 NBT keys (home point, death-item list) so existing bosses load. SynchedEntityData.Builder becomes define(), and Attributes.STEP_HEIGHT becomes setMaxUpStep.
features.savegame_impact: none if the 4.3 boss NBT keys are kept

features.title: Custom RGB boss bars with per-phase colour
features.description: Merged from custom-rgb-boss-bars, tf-boss-bars and custom-boss-bars. ServerTFBossBar, ClientTFBossBar (LerpingBossEvent) and TFBossBarPacket allow any bar colour and overlay, restyled mid-fight with lerping. Examples: Lich gold NOTCHED_6 while shielded, Hydra 0x05EBB9, Knight Phantom 0x86BF37. Bars are drawn in CustomizeGuiOverlayEvent.BossEventProgress. Knight Phantoms get a plural title.
features.reason: Forge 47 has BossEventProgress. 1.20.2+ blitSprite('boss_bar/white_*') must be redone with textures/gui/bars.png UVs. Needs an AT for BossHealthOverlay.events and a SimpleChannel packet.

features.title: Knight Phantom death animation and shared loot
features.description: Merged from knight-phantom-rework and boss-bar-death-anim-kp-rework. Dying phantoms float up, shed item particles, become untouchable and swirl as smoke. Loot moves to the entity table: each dead knight passes its rolls to a survivor, and the last one adds entities/knight_phantom_defeated and deposits it into a dark_chest. Fixes: #1920 TotalKnownKnights persisted with an off-by-one, /kill now kills them, the bar shows only on the leader, and KILL_ALL_PHANTOMS is granted to nearby players.
features.reason: Coordinates several entities. reloadableRegistries().getLootTable becomes server.getLootData(). The looting provider uses EnchantmentHelper.getMobLooting.
features.savegame_impact: new loot table id; Knight Stronghold boss loot moves from the stronghold_boss chest table to the entity table

features.title: Hydra death animation, name-taggable heads, head reload fix
features.description: Merged from hydra-death-and-named-heads and hydra-death-animation. The 1.7-style death animation returns: HydraPart.markedDead makes neck and head segments explode in sequence. Individual heads can be name-tagged, using a string_list serializer and HeadNames NBT. Fixes the wrong heads reactivating after a reload (NumHeads stored as a bitmask) and HydraPart hitboxes (#1935).
features.reason: Register the serializer through ForgeRegistries.Keys.ENTITY_DATA_SERIALIZERS. The name tag uses the hover name instead of DataComponents.CUSTOM_NAME.
features.savegame_impact: NumHeads changes from a count to a bitmask, so a Hydra alive in a save may reload once with a different head set; new serializer id

features.title: Ur-Ghast decoupled from Ghastguard, trap and fireball fixes
features.description: UrGhast gets its own attack, look and flight goals. Player-reflected fireballs now damage it. Trap damage does not count toward tantrum phase switching, and it drops its target while trapped. Ghastlings go through finalizeMobSpawn. Adds a descending death with fire rendering and redstone dust particles.
features.reason: Straight Java. The only API change is the LargeFireball constructor.

features.title: Lich fight bugfixes (clones persisted, teleport home, no self-hits)
features.description: Merged from lich-boss-fixes and the bugfix part of lich-boss-fight-tweaks. Shadow clones are saved in the Lich's NBT (SummonedClones, MasterLich) so they stay linked across reloads and do not despawn at once. The Lich teleports back when more than 8 blocks from its spawn room or down the stairs. Lich bolts no longer hit the owner, clones or wand bolts. Lich bombs spare items and other bombs. Shield break handling is fixed (#1998), the phase-2 suicide is fixed, and the CANDLE_MAP null check is added (#2563).
features.reason: Entity logic only, and it works in the old 4.3 tower. It is the low-risk subset of lich-boss-rework.

features.title: Rising Zombie overhaul (hidden until looked at, then digs out)
features.description: rising_zombie stays invisible and immobile underground until a player within half its follow range looks toward it. It then rises over 130 ticks with a growing hitbox and block particles, and converts to a vanilla zombie keeping its health. It is immune to IN_WALL and has no knockback. A new RisingZombieRenderer scales the model by rise progress. It is added to #minecraft:zombies.
features.reason: Plain entity code. getDefaultDimensions becomes getDimensions/refreshDimensions.
features.savegame_impact: none (same id; existing rising zombies switch to the new behaviour)

features.title: Death Tome lectern ambush tweaks
features.description: A Death Tome on a lectern now ambushes only non-sneaking players within about 3-5.5 blocks who look at it, and hops off with a fixed velocity. Max HP goes from 30 to 20. It no longer takes fall damage, and its hitbox is 0.75x1.5. No hostile tome or lectern traps generate on Peaceful.
features.reason: Plain AI code. PlayerDetector (1.20.3+) becomes Level.hasNearbyAlivePlayer.

features.title: Dedicated sounds for beetles, helmet crab, penguin, squirrel, troll and deer
features.description: Merged from both new-mob-sounds entries, beetle-crab-sounds and the sound part of visual-audio-polish. Adds 63 .ogg files and 49 subtitles. Fire, pinch and slime beetles, helmet crab, penguin, squirrel and troll get ambient, hurt and death sounds, plus pinch attack, troll grab and throw rock, and deer eat and crunch. In 4.3 these mobs use spider sounds or are silent.
features.reason: Sound registration is identical. Add getAmbientSound/getHurtSound overrides to about 7 entities.

features.title: Helmet Crab model rework and rare blue variant
features.description: Merged from helmet-crab-rework and helmet-crab-blue-variant. The helmet rotates independently with head yaw. A 1/10000 blue variant is saved as NBT 'blue' with texture helmetcrabblue.png. Adds an ambient sound and AlwaysWatchTargetGoal (#2578).
features.reason: Model, renderer and synced data. renderToBuffer takes floats instead of an ARGB int.

features.title: Mob balance tweaks (troll, yeti, squirrel, tiny bird, hostile wolf)
features.description: Troll speed goes from 0.28 to 0.25, with a randomized rock cooldown and rider offset. Yetis stay angry, and their follow boost goes from 24 to 8. Squirrel HP goes from 1 to 6 and Tiny Bird from 1 to 4. Hostile wolves target prey, land turtles and skeletons. The Mist Wolf fades properly in light (#2497/#2499).
features.reason: Number changes and goal additions. Skip the WolfVariant part (see the excluded hostile-wolf-variants).

features.title: Passive mob tempt items as item tags
features.description: Merged from passive-tempt-tags and tempt-item-tags. Boar, deer, dwarf rabbit, penguin, raven, squirrel and tiny bird use #twilightforest:<mob>_tempt_items, and Raven and FlyingBird gain tempt goals, so the pack can add modded crops by KubeJS.
features.reason: Ingredient.of(TagKey) works on 1.20.1.

features.title: Shika Senbei deer cracker
features.description: Merged from shika-senbei-deer and two shika-senbei entries. A food item (4 food, 1.0 saturation) in deer tempt items. Right-clicking a hurt deer heals it by 4 with a crunch sound. Found in basement chest loot and, once the trunk is ported, in fallen_trunk_loot.
features.reason: About 30 lines of code plus assets.

features.title: Pinch Beetle rider desync fix and boat smashing
features.description: Merged from hostile-mount-fixes and pinch-beetle-behaviour. The victim is dropped on death. The rider desync is fixed (#2091). Grabbing a rider in a boat smashes the boat. The food bar shows while riding a hostile mount (bbe5c81b0).
features.reason: Small overrides. Boat#getVariant().getPlanks() exists in 1.20.1. Remove the 'BEMTI' debug log.

features.title: Ice Bomb projectile rework
features.description: A direct hit deals double frozen damage and chill. A block hit freezes a radius-2 diamond that grows to radius 3. The zone lasts 101 ticks and uses SNOW_GUARDIAN particles. Used by the item and the Alpha Yeti.
features.reason: Self-contained projectile logic.

features.title: Block and Chain rework (rendered links, break tags, adventure mode, world border)
features.description: Merged from block-and-chain-fixes and block-and-chain-break-tags. The Chain part entities are dropped, and links render client-side about 1.5 per metre. Breaking is governed by #mineable_with_block_and_chain with a tier from the Destruction level and never touches #block_and_chain_never_breaks (#2109). Decorated pots break (#2108). Block and Chain and the Cube of Annihilation respect adventure CanDestroy (#1512), and Block and Chain refuses to work outside the world border. Fixes #2144, #2199, #2205.
features.reason: Tier.createToolProperties (1.20.5) becomes TierSortingRegistry.isCorrectTierForDrops. #2205 uses the 1.21 SmashBlocksEffect; keep 4.3's DestructionEnchantment check.

features.title: Progression lock overhaul (no block placing, per-piece protection)
features.description: Merged from progression-protection-overhaul, progression-placement-lock and progression-protection-render-rewrite. Locked structures also block single and multi-block placement (#1203) and resync the inventory after a cancel. Protection is evaluated per StructurePiece (ProgressionPiece#isComponentProtected) instead of per start box. StructureProtectionPacket carries per-piece boxes inflated by 4, so the protection rain renders only over protected pieces, also with 0 particles or clouds off. portalCreationPermission replaces adminOnlyPortals. Already done elsewhere, skip here: portalCreationPermission (and the legacy adminOnlyPortals fallback) was ported in config-option-additions (commit 5d070d8); the permission check lives in 4.3's TFTickHandler portal scan, not in ProgressionEvents. Do not define the ForgeConfigSpec key again.
features.reason: The Forge events exist (EntityPlaceEvent, EntityMultiPlaceEvent). ProgressionPiece is added to 4.3 pieces with protected as the default. The packet uses FriendlyByteBuf.

features.title: Fortification shield HUD indicator, sounds and fixes
features.description: Merged from fortification-shield-rework, fortification-shield-polish and hud-shield-mount-food. Adds a HUD row of shield icons (configs fortificationShieldIndicator and ...InCreative), directional break particles, expire and block sounds, and i-frame-based breaking. Counts are clamped to 0..115. Temporary shields last 50% longer with the Mystic Crown. Lich shield rendering is fixed.
features.reason: Maps 1:1 onto 4.3's shield capability and UpdateShieldPacket. The overlay goes through RegisterGuiOverlaysEvent with a plain blit.

features.title: Misc gameplay event tweaks
features.description: Endermen cannot pick up blocks in the TF dimension. Lich bombs do not destroy items. The Ender Bow no longer swaps places with bosses. The Minotaur Axe charge applies to any sprinting attacker. Mazebreaker acceleration is driven by the block tag mazebreaker_accelerated.
features.reason: Standard Forge events.

features.title: Twilight portal warm-up delay, gamerules and overlay
features.description: Merged from tf-portal-delay-gamerules, tf-portal-warmup-overlay and the gamerule part of portal-gamerules-and-tf-tp. A player must stand in the portal for playersTfPortalDefaultDelay ticks (default 60; creative uses playersTfPortalCreativeDelay, default 1) instead of 4.3's instant transfer, which allowed knockback ping-pong. A purple overlay fades in, open GUIs close, and the timer decays when the player leaves.
features.reason: The 1.21 Portal#getPortalTransitionTime does not exist. Implement the timer in a player capability ticked in PlayerTickEvent and gate TFPortalBlock#attemptSendEntity on it. Register the GameRules in enqueueWork, and draw the overlay with RegisterGuiOverlaysEvent.

features.title: Locked-biome weather renderer rewrite (1.7 parity)
features.description: Merged from both weather-renderer-rewrite entries. TFWeatherRenderer is rewritten to match the 1.7 blizzard, mosquito, ashes, dark stream and big rain effects. Includes cloud tick fixes and static render setup.
features.reason: Uses DimensionSpecialEffects#renderSnowAndRain, which exists on 1.20.1. The 1.21 BufferBuilder/Tesselator calls need a mechanical back-port. Drop the /tick freeze hook.

features.title: Rabbit's Pocket Watch
features.description: Merged from two pocket-watch entries. In the hotbar or offhand it gives Speed I and Jump Boost I; held, it adds Haste and blocks Mining Fatigue (MobEffectEvent.Applicable, #2097). Found in hill_2 and rare TF chest pools.
features.reason: An inventoryTick item; the event exists on Forge 47.

features.title: Mystic Crown and Crown Splinters
features.description: Merged from two mystic-crown entries. crown_splinter comes from Lich Tower chests, and 8 splinters craft mystic_crown, an Equipable head item with +2 armor.
features.reason: Equipable exists in 1.20.1, and modifiers go through getAttributeModifiers. Until the tower is ported, add splinters to 4.3's tower_library and tower_room loot.

features.title: Baby Loyal Zombies
features.description: LoyalZombie gets its own baby state (+50% speed, half size, IsBaby NBT, fixed size and speed). With the Mystic Crown worn, the Zombie Scepter summons a baby 10% of the time.
features.reason: Simple entity code. EntityDimensions.withEyeHeight becomes getStandingEyeHeight.

features.title: Emperor's Cloth (invisible armor) and no-template smithing
features.description: Merged from both emperors-cloth entries and emperors-cloth-fixes. emperors_cloth, found in the hedge_cloth loot table, is applied to #emperors_cloth_applicable armor by crafting or by smithing without a template. The armor piece stops rendering (armor, elytra and cape all fixed, #2491) and no longer counts toward mob detection while invisible. It washes off in a water cauldron.
features.reason: Sweeps disagreed between easy and medium. Medium, because 4.3 has no armor.js (its META-INF/asm holds book, cloud, conquered, foliage, lead, maprendercontext, mount, multipart, music, reach, seed, shroom). New JS coremods are needed for HumanoidArmorLayer.renderArmorPiece, ElytraLayer, CapeLayer and LivingEntity.getVisibilityPercent; base them on the Jan-2024 JS version (c5e562b57). The component becomes a boolean NBT tag.

features.title: Ore Meter implemented (scan, HUD table, filter)
features.description: Merged from ore-meter, ore-meter-rework, ore-meter-hud and ore-meter-implementation. The 4.3 ore_meter is NYI-tagged (checked) and only prints to chat. In 4.8 it scans server-side over several ticks (up to a 2-chunk radius), shows a HUD table (block, count, ratio) with per-ore colours, filters by right-clicking a block, changes range when sneaking, and is wiped by left-clicking air (WipeOreMeterPacket). Adds sounds and an active model, and loot in hill_1.
features.reason: Five components become NBT. The ore_map_color data map becomes the JSON listener from shared infra. The HUD is a RegisterGuiOverlaysEvent overlay. The Feb-2024 version is a cleaner starting point than HEAD.

features.title: Brittle and Greater Potion Flask finished
features.description: Merged from potion-flask-polish, brittle-flask-rework, potion-flask-tooltip and brittle-flask-polish. In 4.3 both flasks are WIP (checked). The brittle flask holds 3 doses minus breakage and breaks at breakage 3 or more. Flasks fill by stacking a potion onto them in the inventory (#2531), split copies only out of stacks, and drop the bottle when the inventory is full. A tooltip component shows a dose bar. Includes advancement fixes, the failed_challenge damage type, and a place in Lich Tower and hut loot.
features.reason: PotionContents and PotionFlaskComponent become 4.3's NBT ('Potion', 'Uses', 'Breakage'). The tooltip uses a plain blit, and overrideStackedOnOther exists in 1.20.1.
features.savegame_impact: none (flask NBT layout may change for WIP flasks)

features.title: Uncrafting Table recipe book, fixes and config
features.description: Merged from uncrafting-table-improvements, uncrafting-table-gui-qol and uncrafting-recipe-book. Adds a vanilla recipe book with ghost placement (UncraftingRecipeBookComponent, UncraftingPlaceRecipe), button tooltips, and a disableIngredientSwitching config. Fixes: positioned re-craft sub-grids, enchantment merging without copying damage (#2079/#2080), non-enchantable results no longer getting enchants (22dc7f67f), #2009 and #2011. Already done elsewhere, skip here: disableIngredientSwitching was ported in config-option-additions (commit 5d070d8), including the extra boolean in SyncUncraftingTableConfigPacket (after allowShapeless), the UncraftingGuiPacket server-side guard and the network protocol bump to "2-skytekx.3". Do not define the ForgeConfigSpec key or bump the protocol again for it.
features.reason: RecipeBookMenu and PlaceRecipe exist in 1.20.1, but use Recipe<?> plus id instead of RecipeHolder. Enchantments go back to the Map<Enchantment,Integer> API. The fixes alone are worth taking.

features.title: Magic Paintings finished: frames, opacity modifiers, 3 new paintings
features.description: Merged from magic-painting-upgrades (x2), magic-paintings-expansion, magic-painting-variants, magic-painting-render-improvements and magic-painting-item. 4.3 has the datapack registry and 2 variants (darkness, lucid_lands), but the item is NYI (checked). This adds castaway_paradise, music_in_the_mire and the_hostile_paradise; a reworked lucid_lands; author as a Component; back_texture; per-layer local_lighting; and opacity modifiers (day_time, sine_time, health, hunger, holding_item, mob_effect_category, lightning). Also frames and backing, a largely rewritten renderer, and gallery placement. The Lich Tower magic gallery uses them.
features.reason: Extends 4.3's existing codec and renderer. ComponentSerialization.CODEC becomes ExtraCodecs.COMPONENT, getU/getV take 0-16, and the vertex colour API changes. Remove the debug displayClientMessage from 3c079b73a.
features.savegame_impact: new ids only (existing painting variant ids kept)

features.title: Magic Map conquered markers, charting tag, data-driven colours, Quest Grove conquerable
features.description: Merged from magic-map-improvements, magic-map-landmark-improvements, magic-map-conquered-markers, data-driven-map-colors (x2) and quest-grove-conquerable. Conquered landmarks get a red X (TFMagicMapData.conqueredStructures, synced in MagicMapPacket). A dimension_type tag allows_magic_map_charting is added. magic_map_color and ore_map_color become data-driven. The Quest Grove counts as conquered once the ram's reward is used up. Also: skipKnownStructures is honoured, a held map renders on join, there are hover texts, maze map tooltip fixes, and sounds on empty maps.
features.reason: Draw the X in 4.3's TFMapDecoration#render path (maprendercontext.js) instead of the 1.20.5 IMapDecorationRenderer. Port from the pre-1.20.5 commit e67ac0be2. The colours use the JSON listener from shared infra.
features.savegame_impact: none (map data gains an optional list)

features.title: Datapack-driven Questing Ram quest
features.description: Merged from four questing-ram entries. The required wool colours and the reward loot come from data/twilightforest/twilight/quests/questing_ram.json (QuestingRamContext, QuestReloadListener), synced to clients with SyncQuestsPacket for the crosshair indicator. Jade and TOP wool providers are updated. Fixes #2328/#2329 and enlarges the culling box.
features.reason: AddReloadListenerEvent and OnDatapackSyncEvent exist on Forge 47. Ingredient has no codec in 1.20.1, so parse with Ingredient.fromJson. Beanification becomes a static holder. Lets AlmostUnified and KubeJS tune the quest.

features.title: Wrought Iron Fence finished (finials, posts) and Wrought Iron Bar
features.description: Merged from both wrought-iron-fence-finials entries and the bar from minor-new-items. The fence is WIP in 4.3. WroughtIronFenceItem toggles finials on top posts; a 4-way junction creates a post. Rotation and structure-void fixes (#1933, #2254, #2261), and hardness 8/20. Adds wrought_iron_bar, tagged ingots/wrought_iron; the recipe is 6 bars for 3 fences.
features.reason: 4.3 already has the block with the same POST and FenceSide states. Used 138 times in the Lich Tower templates.
features.savegame_impact: new ids only (existing fence states compatible)

features.title: Canopy Window and Window Pane
features.description: Merged from two canopy-window entries. A decorative glass block and pane framed in canopy wood, with recipes.
features.reason: Use GlassBlock instead of TransparentBlock, and IronBarsBlock. Not referenced by the Lich Tower templates (checked), so it is optional.

features.title: Terrorcotta Arcs, Curves and Lines
features.description: Merged from terrorcotta-blocks, terrorcotta-arcs and the terrorcotta part of lich-tower-decor-blocks. terrorcotta_arcs (RotatedPillarBlock with special column models), terrorcotta_curves (GlazedTerracottaBlock) and terrorcotta_lines (BinaryRotatedBlock), with stonecutting.
features.reason: Trivial blocks. The Lich Tower templates use them heavily (curves 123, lines 96, arcs 62 references).

features.title: Generic connected-texture model loader
features.description: Merged from two connected-texture-loader entries. 4.3's castle-door-only CTM loader becomes twilightforest:connected_texture_block, configured with connectable_blocks. It is applied to castle doors, arctic_fur_block and auroralized_glass (their _ctm textures already ship unused in 4.3).
features.reason: The Forge IGeometryLoader API is equivalent. This renames and parameterizes 4.3's client/model/block/doors.

features.title: Coronation Carpet (connected carpet)
features.description: Merged from coronation-carpet (x2), coronation-carpet-model and coronation-carpet-rename. A red WoolCarpetBlock with a border-aware RoyalRagsModel geometry loader, in the wool_carpets tag. Mobs can always spawn on it, and it is the Sinister Spawner's spawn surface.
features.reason: Checked: royal_rags never existed in 4.3, so register coronation_carpet directly and no remap is needed (one sweep claimed otherwise). Used 96 times in the Lich Tower templates.

features.title: Rope block and item
features.description: Merged from rope and rope-block. A climbable, scaffolding-like rope on three axes that is waterloggable and supported by neighbours. RopeItem extends placement up to 7 blocks along the clicked axis. Recipe: 3 root_strand for 8 rope. Used in the firefly canopy tree decoration, the simple well template and the Lich Tower.
features.reason: Vanilla-only block logic. isScaffolding is a Forge hook in 1.20.1, and the useItemOn split folds back into use().

features.title: Trapped chests for all 8 TF woods
features.description: Merged from tf-wood-trapped-chests, tf-trapped-chests and the trapped part of chest-renderers. Adds twilight oak, canopy, mangrove, dark, time, transformation, mining and sorting trapped chests, with textures, recipes (chest + tripwire hook) and loot.
features.reason: Use the Dec-2023 design (d667919fd): TFTrappedChestBlock with its own tf_trapped_chest BE on top of 4.3's TFChestBlock and TwilightChestEntity. Not the later 4.8 move to vanilla BE types, which needs BlockEntityTypeAddBlocksEvent.

features.title: Maze Slime Ball and Maze Slime Block
features.description: Maze slimes drop maze_slime_ball, which compresses into maze_slime_block, a SlimeBlock that sticks only to itself and #mazestone. Adds maze-ball variants of the lead, magma cream and sticky piston recipes.
features.reason: canStickTo and isStickyBlock are Forge hooks in 1.20.1.

features.title: Keepsake Casket finished and Skull Chest fallback
features.description: Merged from keepsake-casket-skull-chest, skull-chest, the casket parts of casket-and-repair-recipes, and the skull part of chest-renderers. The casket is WIP in 4.3. Breakage moves onto the item (KeepsakeCasketItem, named after the owner, damaged variants in the creative tab). At damage 2 or more, a failed 15% roll on death places a skull_chest (BE, BER, multilogged, owner-locked, sounds) instead. Adds casket_repair_recipe (casket + Charm of Keeping III), rotation and mirror, a BlockLoggingEnum fix, and JEI subtypes.
features.reason: 4.3 already has KeepsakeCasketBlock.BREAKAGE (damage 0-2) and the roll in CharmEvents. CASKET_DAMAGE becomes item NBT, ResolvableProfile becomes GameProfile, and CraftingInput becomes CraftingContainer. The Lich Tower casket room places caskets.

features.title: Candelabra overhaul (any candles, dim/ominous lighting, comparator)
features.description: Merged from candelabra-overhaul, candelabra-candle-overhaul, candelabra-qol, the candelabra part of lighting-decor-renderers, and block-component-glue. The candelabra is WIP in 4.3, a plain Block with no BE (checked). It becomes a BaseEntityBlock holding up to 3 arbitrary candles, with has_candle_1..3 and a lerped BER. Redstone dims it and essence or scepters make it ominous. Light scales with candle count, comparator output is added, and it has a recipe, dispenser behaviour, the dim_flame particle and sounds. Fixes #2189, #2213, #2255.
features.reason: CANDELABRA_DATA becomes BlockEntityTag NBT, and the BER replaces 4.3's baked variants. The Lich Tower templates (179 candelabras) store BE 'Candles' data, so without this port tower candelabras load without candles.

features.title: Carminite Reactor debris mimics nearby blocks (1.7 look)
features.description: Merged from reactor-debris-visual, reactor-debris-visuals and reactor-debris-be. reactor_debris becomes a BE block with random size and per-face textures, rendered by a BER, plus a break-particle sprite via ModelData. Loading is hardened (#2183, #2250).
features.reason: A standard BE and BER. ModelData and BakedModelWrapper exist on Forge 47.

features.title: Trollsteinn light reaction and lit item model
features.description: Merged from trollsteinn-light-states and two trollsteinn-lit-item entries. Faces update on placement and random tick from per-side light. The item shows a lit model in light (TrollsteinnModel). Fixes night flicker (#2078).
features.reason: Small. Port only the final version (9117281b3); the intermediate one references ClientLevel and crashes dedicated servers (#2484).

features.title: Uberous Soil improvements
features.description: Merged from uberous-soil-improvements and uberous-soil-rework. Placed under a bonemealable plant, it applies 15 bonemeals through a FakePlayer and turns to dirt (#2121). Adds particles and fixes light occlusion (#2051).
features.reason: FakePlayerFactory exists in Forge 47.

features.title: Magic tree core and ore magnet particles
features.description: Merged from both tree-core-particles entries and the particle part of visual-audio-polish. Adds log_core_particle and transformation_particle from the Time and Transformation cores, sorting particle tweaks, an ore magnet trail, and a leaf rune fix. Tree core configs are cached.
features.reason: Standard particle types.

features.title: Dark Tower and Labyrinth miniature structures
features.description: Enables dark_tower_miniature_structure and minotaur_labyrinth_miniature_structure with detailed models, used as advancement icons, and refreshes the existing miniature models.
features.reason: 4.3 has MiniatureStructureBlock and the same commented-out registrations. Keep 4.3's lich_tower miniature unless the revamp is ported.

features.title: Small block QoL changes
features.description: Merged from block-qol-bundle, banister-improvements and the #2119 part of skull-candle-changes. Banister placement is reworked and mobs treat banisters as FENCE (4.3 returns BLOCKED). Hollow log sounds and waterlogging are fixed. Spiral bricks become waterloggable. Critters can sit on leaves, and moonworms are waterloggable again. Sneak-clicking a skull candle removes candles, keeping its BE storage (#2119). Fallen leaves are fixed, and lily pads get walk sounds.
features.reason: Small, independent changes. Moving the skull candle count into the blockstate (af0f724d1) is deliberately excluded.

features.title: Item polish (animations, particles, sounds)
features.description: Crumble Horn tooting animation. Red Thread texture by stack size. Lifedrain particle trail (LifedrainParticlePacket), with the rotten-flesh bonus moved to a loot table. Peacock fan particles visible to others (#1962). Lamp of Cinders AOE in front of the player. Handheld models for the lamp, magnet and moonworm queen.
features.reason: Small isolated diffs. The packet goes on the SimpleChannel.

features.title: JEI plugin upgrades (uncrafting XP cost, layout, FakeEntityType)
features.description: Merged from jei-plugin-upgrades, recipe-viewer-uncrafting-cost and the JEI part of recipe-viewer-compat-emi-rei. features.reason: JEI 15.20 is in the pack and has the same category and extension APIs, using Recipe instead of RecipeHolder.

features.title: TF small lakes, frozen lakes, lakes in more biomes
features.description: Merged from two small-lakes entries. TFSmallLakeFeature (twilightforest:small_lake) has an ice provider and the tag small_lakes_dont_replace, so lakes no longer leave floating trees or crash. Water lakes return to most forest biomes at 1/32. Snowy Forest gets frozen_lake, and Enchanted Forest gets dense_water_lake.
features.reason: A self-contained feature on vanilla APIs.
features.savegame_impact: new ids only; new chunks only

features.title: Enchanted Forest vegetation overhaul
features.description: Merged from enchanted-forest-overhaul and enchanted-forest-fixup. Adds EnchantedForestVinesFeature (TOP_LAYER_MODIFICATION, never on rainbow oak leaves), dense ferns and large ferns, denser canopy and rainbow oaks (0.10 to 0.15), bigger circles and fewer mayapples (#2275). The biome terrain depth and scale part is excluded with the chunkgen overhaul.
features.reason: A simple feature plus biome data.
features.savegame_impact: new ids only; new chunks only

features.title: Dark Forest ground cover and oak/dark-oak bushes
features.description: Merged from dark-forest-ground-and-bushes and the bush part of biome-vegetation-tweaks. The Dark Forest loses flowers and dark ferns, gains brown and red mushrooms and more grass, and uses tag-based predicates. tree/dark_oak_bush and tree/oak_bush (with dense variants) appear in Swamp, Fire Swamp and Dense Forest, replacing jungle_bush.
features.reason: Data only, using existing feature types. Keep minecraft:grass, since the short_grass rename does not apply on 1.20.1.
features.savegame_impact: new ids only (dark_mushrooms dropped); new chunks only

features.title: Misc biome vegetation and placement tuning
features.description: Merged from vegetation-placement-misc, vegetation-overhaul (remaining parts) and the vegetation parts of biome-vegetation-tweaks and biome-spawn-tuning. Adds TF-owned patch_grass_* that avoid structure zones, large ferns in forests, classic Highlands (birch, sparse mushglooms, podzol), and fern blocks. Raises the snowy forest selector chances, removes hanging roots, gives snow_under_trees a heightmap, adds biome filters, shifts mangroves to the surface, and lets spooky webs embed in leaves.
features.reason: Data and BiomeHelper only. 4.8 registers minecraft:patch_tall_grass, patch_large_fern and flower_forest_flowers, which override vanilla overworld placements; put them in the twilightforest namespace instead.

features.title: Canopy forest density fix and 1.7.10-style canopy trees
features.description: Merged from canopy-tree-shape-and-density and canopy-tree-legacy-shapes. placed tree/selector/canopy_trees gets count 7-8; in 4.3 it tries only one canopy tree per chunk. Leaf blobs return to the 1.7.10 shape. BranchingTrunkPlacer gains branch_provider (wood branches) and prevent_exposed_root. The darkwood branch height is fixed. The firefly canopy tree dangles rope.
features.reason: Two optional codec fields and data. Keep canopy_fence for the dangle until rope exists.
features.savegame_impact: worldgen change, new chunks only (denser forests)

features.title: Mega Canopy trees and Mega Oak rename
features.description: Merged from mega-trees, mega-canopy-and-mega-oak and mega-canopy-oak-trees. Adds mega_canopy (2x2, 1.4.7 leaf circles, 1/20 in forest and mushroom biomes) grown from 2x2 canopy saplings. canopy_oak is renamed to mega_oak (tree/forest_mega_oak_tree, tree/savannah_mega_oak_tree), with firefly placement fixed (#2067).
features.reason: Uses TFTreeFeature and FeaturePlacers from 4.3. The 1.20.3 TreeGrower becomes AbstractMegaTreeGrower. Keep the old canopy_oak ids as aliases in case datapacks reference them.
features.savegame_impact: new ids only (configured feature ids not persisted); new chunks only

features.title: TF cave carver rework (tf_caves)
features.description: Far fewer cave systems (bound 15 to 4). Occasional dish-floored rooms. Slower descent near bedrock. Never exposes or replaces water. Noise-driven dirt walls. Rooted dirt under liquid. Replaces #twilightforest:carver_replaceables. Radius multiplier 1.05, minimum Y above_bottom 16. Fixes the off-by-one room centre.
features.reason: Same WorldCarver API. The constructor gains a BlockStateProvider. Builds on the shared-random fix from worldgen-crash-fixes.
features.savegame_impact: new chunks only (seams in caves at old and new chunk borders)

features.title: Highlands Underground biome, troll-cave tunnels and troll-cave vegetation
features.description: Merged from highlands-underground-troll-caves, troll-cave-vegetation-fix and the carver and biome part of caves-trollcave-gianthouse. The new biome highlands_underground fills the -3 layer under the Highlands. It carries the highland_caves carver, now gated to a diagonal chunk grid around the landmark centres (wide tunnels around Troll Caves), plus troll roots and mushglooms. Cave-safe features are added (troll_cave_huge_red/brown_mushroom, troll_cave_big_mushgloom, underground_plants_in_structure) with the tag cannot_troll_cave_hollow (#2266).
features.reason: Checked: 4.3's dimension JSON already supports per-column biome_layers ('-3.0': twilightforest:underground), so the biome is added without the terrain rewrite. The carver needs the manhattanDistanceFromLandmarkCenter helper in 4.3's LegacyLandmarkPlacements.
features.savegame_impact: new biome id; underground Highlands differ in new chunks (a TF dimension reset is recommended for consistency, not required)

features.title: Ruined Foundations revamp, Hollow Stumps, Druid Hut loot and template tweaks
features.description: Merged from ruins-and-feature-templates, ruined-foundations-revamp, ruined-foundations-hollow-stumps and druid-hut-and-feature-templates. FoundationFeature uses RuinedFoundationConfig: wood BlockFamilies, wall widths and heights, basements with foundation_basement loot, placed in SURFACE_STRUCTURES. Hollow stumps are restored. DruidHutFeature handles junk chests and barrels (chests/hut_junk) and painting sizes. Wells and stone circle templates are tweaked.

features.savegame_impact: new loot table ids; new chunks only

features.title: Berry bushes (4 surface, 4 Dark Tower), berries and worldgen
features.description: Merged from both berry-bushes entries and both berry-bush-worldgen entries. Adds the TFBushBlock base (age 0-3, harvest by right-click via loot table, snow-loggable through SnowLoggable). Surface bushes: raspberry, blueberry, blackberry and maloberry (BerryBushBlock). Dark Tower bushes: blightberry, duskberry, skyberry and stingberry (DarkTowerBerryBushBlock), placed in DarkTowerMainComponent. StackableEffectItem berries stack effect durations, with chance-based side effects. Adds berry_medley. The berry_bush feature spawns taxicab clusters in forest, highland, snowy and swamp biomes.
features.reason: Plain blocks, items and a feature. Needed changes: Holder<MobEffect> to MobEffect, ItemAbilities to ToolActions, PathType to BlockPathTypes, use() instead of the split interaction methods, StateHolder#trySetValue replaced by hasProperty, compostables via ComposterBlock, and the snowy-grass ASM hook either dropped or done as a mixin. The camp templates place these bushes.
features.savegame_impact: new ids and placed features; new chunks and newly generated Dark Towers only

features.title: Oreberry bushes (iron, gold, copper, essence) and copper nugget
features.description: Merged from both oreberries entries and oreberry-worldgen. Underground TFBushBlocks that hurt entities (oreberry damage type) and survive only in darkness. They drop iron, gold and copper berries, which smelt to nuggets, and essence_berry gives 6-19 XP. Adds copper_nugget. Placed by the oreberry_bushes feature (UndergroundPlantFeature) at y -10..-8, kept out of structures (#2532), with a pathing fix (#2528).
features.reason: Reuses TFBushBlock. Map c: tags to forge:. twilightforest:copper_nugget collides with create:copper_nugget (Create 6.0.8 is in the pack), so add it to config/almostunified unify and set modPriorities.
features.savegame_impact: new ids only; new chunks only

features.title: Datapack-driven structure speleothem settings
features.description: Merged from speleothem-config-datadriven and speleothem-configs. The StructureSpeleothem enum is replaced by the datapack registry twilight/structure_speleothem_settings (small, medium and large hollow hill, hydra_lair, yeti_cave, troll_cave), with lattice spacing and ore lists. The stalactite configs move to twilight/stalactites. Modpacks can then put modded ores into hollow hills by datapack. Includes lattice iterator fixes.
features.reason: Uses DataPackRegistryEvent.NewRegistry. The structure codecs gain a holder field, so the TF structure JSONs change. Keep the old data/twilightforest/stalactites path readable as a fallback.
features.savegame_impact: none for saved data; the datapack path and format change

features.title: Data-driven Dark Forest canopy and glacier blanketing
features.description: Merged from chunk-blanketing-datadriven and chunk-blanketing-processors. ChunkGeneratorTwilight.addDarkForestCanopy and addGlaciers become CanopyBlanketProcessor and GlacierBlanketProcessor, with a chunk_blanket_type registry and the datapack chunk_blanket_processors. Canopy height goes from 19 to 14 and thickness from 1.5x to 1x, the canopy skips water, the avoid_structures list uses chunk references, and RNG is per chunk. The glacier follows the WORLD_SURFACE_WG heightmap; 4.3's y127..0 scan is wrong below 0.
features.reason: No ASM is needed: call the processors from 4.3's ChunkGeneratorTwilight.buildSurface (checked at lines 358-365), where the old methods run. For only the visual retune, change the 4.3 parameters (about 2h).
features.savegame_impact: canopy and glacier shape change in new chunks; new registries only

features.title: Giant Hollow Oaks as datapack-configurable structures (1.7.10 port), swamp variant, sapling growth
features.description: Merged from hollow-tree-structure, hollow-giant-oak-structure and hollow-tree-structure-fixes. 4.3's HollowTreeFeature becomes the twilightforest:hollow_tree structure. Pieces: trunk, roots, large, medium and small branches, and a leaf dungeon with a swarm-spider spawner and tree_cache chest. Heights and block providers are configurable, and swamp_hollow_tree generates in water. The Hollow Oak sapling grows the structure (StructureTreeGrower, TreeGrowerStartable). Placement is avoid_landmark_grid (7/5, frequency 0.5). Fixes #2023, #2028, #2185, leaf decay in dungeons, chunk-edge cutoff, and vines replacing water.
features.reason: Sweeps disagreed between easy and medium. Medium: about 1,350 lines of plain StructurePiece code with only 4.3 blocks, but sapling growth has to be rewritten as an AbstractTreeGrower that starts a structure (the 1.20.3 TreeGrower record does not exist), and the old placed feature must be removed from the BiomeHelper lists.
features.savegame_impact: new ids only; already-generated feature trees stay

features.title: Fallen Trunks (hollow fallen logs with spawner and loot)
features.description: Merged from both fallen-trunk-structure entries and fallen-trunk-terrain-adapt. Hollow fallen twilight oak trunks (17-24 blocks, big 22-28) with eroded ends, moss and holes. Each has a swarm spider, hostile wolf or cave spider spawner and a fallen_trunk_loot chest. TrunkUnderDensityFunction raises at most one mound per side through CustomDensitySource. Adapts to steep terrain. Placement is avoid_landmark_grid (7/5, frequency 0.8) excluding hollow_tree.
features.reason: About 650 self-contained lines with no new blocks. The mounds need the Beardifier bridge; without it, fill the base with blocks.
features.savegame_impact: new ids only; new chunks only
blockers_1_21_api: tf-asm Beardifier hook (replaced by the bridge)

features.title: Aurora Palace floor-plan rework and guaranteed Snow Queen
features.description: IceTowerWingComponent uses floordecorators with 9 weighted floor types, a fallback plan and chests on pillars. IceTowerMainComponent retries addChildren until a boss wing exists, so the Snow Queen is (almost) guaranteed. Fixes doors, roof, bridge and beard intersections, stairs (#2503) and entrance rotation (PR #2166).
features.reason: Pure StructurePiece code in the same icetower package, about 670 lines. The UtilityPiece wing-base protection is optional.
features.savegame_impact: none for piece ids; newly generated palaces only

features.title: Naga Courtyard terrace rework and terrain clearing
features.description: Merged from naga-courtyard-terraces and naga-courtyard-terraces-terraform. The terraces become CourtyardTerrace (TFNCTe) and CourtyardTerraceHedge (TFNCHe), with templates terrace_channel, reservoir, hedge and hedge_big; corners are fixed. NagaCourtyardStructure and HedgeMazeStructure clear terrain above themselves with an inverted-pyramid CustomDensitySource and follow the terrain height. The boss spawner can come from the courtyard/spawner template (for modpacks).

Keep 4.3's direct spawner placement unless the jigsaw framework is in.
features.savegame_impact: keeps the old piece ids as aliases, so existing courtyards load; new courtyards differ

features.title: Troll clouds as a structure piece (giant house cloud fixes)
features.description: Merged from giant-house-split and the structure part of caves-trollcave-gianthouse. In 4.8 the giant house is its own structure, and the troll cloud is a CloudComponent piece (TFCloud) instead of ChunkGeneratorTwilight.deformTerrainForTrollCloud2 stamping. Fixes: wispy edges, clouds no longer overlapping house blocks, and partial troll caves finishing after a reload.
features.reason: 4.3 adaptation: add CloudComponent as a child piece of the existing troll cave start and delete deformTerrainForTrollCloud2 (ChunkGeneratorTwilight line 456), so clouds are not generated twice. Splitting giant_house into its own structure needs the excluded landmark_grid placement.
features.savegame_impact: new piece id TFCloud; old troll caves keep their old cloud; new chunks only

features.title: Final Castle modpack template hooks and punchable WIP text
features.description: The bell tower, boss gazebo and large tower add TwilightJigsawPieces from the pools final_castle/temp/*, so a modpack can supply its own boss arena by datapack. The gazebo 'WIP' text uses TextDisplay and Interaction entities, and punching them removes it (AttackEntityEvent). The castle is centred. The mural part is in worldgen-thread-safety.
features.reason: Display and Interaction entities and AttackEntityEvent exist in 1.20.1. The hooks need the jigsaw framework. Useful if SkyTekx wants a custom endgame arena.

features.title: Density-shaped terrain for Hollow Hills, Hydra Lair, Yeti Cave and Labyrinth (optional)
features.description: In 4.8 these landmarks implement CustomDensitySource (HollowHillFunction mounds, hydra mound, yeti slope without standing water, labyrinth mound) instead of 4.3's block deformers in ChunkGeneratorTwilight (deformTerrainForFeature, raiseHills, deformTerrainForYetiLair). Hollow-hill spawns are limited to a half-dome.
features.reason: Technically possible on top of the Beardifier bridge, but tuned against 4.8's terrain heights, and 4.3's block deformers already work. The payoff is cosmetic and the regression surface is every landmark, hence optional and last. The half-dome spawn limit is a cheap cherry-pick.
features.savegame_impact: changes landmark terrain in new chunks; a TF dimension reset is recommended for consistency
blockers_1_21_api: tf-asm Beardifier hooks (replaced by the bridge)

features.title: Exanimate Essence and Ominous Fire (with zombification)
features.description: Merged from ominous-candles-fire-exanimate-essence (essence and fire part), ominous-fire-exanimate-essence and ominous-fire-zombification. exanimate_essence (stack 16) drops from the Lich and tower loot. Used on the ground it places ominous_fire, which damages non-undead (damage type ominous_fire). Kills convert villager, piglin and horse to their zombie forms, and dead players leave a zombie with their skin. It also makes candelabras ominous and recharges scepters.
features.reason: The NeoForge DataMapType becomes the JSON listener from shared infra. Uses Mob.convertTo plus ForgeEventFactory.canLivingConvert. The zombified-player profile goes into a capability and a renderer layer. Add the essence to 4.3's entities/lich loot.

features.title: Ominous Candles (17 colours)
features.description: Using essence on a lit vanilla candle turns it into ominous_candle or ominous_<colour>_candle: a CandleBlock with a BE and a bobbing BER with purple flames. Loot returns the vanilla candles.
features.reason: All the APIs exist on 1.20.1; the work is mostly datagen volume (17 blockstates and loot tables).

features.title: Sinister Spawner
features.description: Merged from two sinister-spawner entries. A BaseSpawner block (SinisterSpawnerLogic) that lazily scans safe spawn spots, can spawn on coronation carpet, and has configurable particles and separate scan and spawn ranges. It drops 15-45 XP plus blocks/ominous_spawner_drops. Includes /tf sinister_spawner. Placed by spawner_processor in Lich Tower bridges and rooms.
features.reason: BaseSpawner, SpawnData and CustomSpawnRules exist in 1.20.1 with slightly different signatures, and some ATs are needed. Register sinister_spawner directly; the cursed_spawner rename never reached 4.3.

features.title: Jar revamp: swappable log lids, wobble, Mason Jar
features.description: Merged from jar-revamp-mason-jar, mason-jar-and-jar-lids, jar-rework-client, mason-jar-fixes and the jar part of block-component-glue. firefly_jar, cicada_jar and moonworm_jar become BE-backed (twilightforest:jar) with 41 swappable log lids and a wobble animation. mason_jar holds and displays one stack, takes loot (tower_jars), exposes an item handler, and catches critters. Adds jar sounds and a Halloween pumpkin lid. Fixes #2210, #2215, #2216.
features.reason: JarLid and CONTAINER become BlockEntityTag NBT, the capability is a Forge ICapabilityProvider, and SetMasonJarItemPacket goes on the SimpleChannel. The JARRED ItemDisplayContext uses Forge's IExtensibleEnum.create or plain display transforms. HolidayEvent becomes a static util.
features.savegame_impact: new ids; existing 4.3 firefly and cicada jars (no BE in 4.3, checked) gain a BE with the default twilight_oak lid, which is compatible

features.title: Chiseled Canopy Bookshelf (book-fed Death Tome spawner)
features.description: Merged from two chiseled-canopy-bookshelf entries, death-tome-shelf-tweaks and the shelf part of block-component-glue. A ChiseledBookShelfBlock subclass with a SPAWNER state. BookshelfSpawner consumes books from its slots to release Death Tomes near players, does not consume them on Peaceful, burns its books when set on fire, and can hold an enchanted book in generated towers. Includes an item handler and Jade/TOP providers (#2105, #2106, #2112, #2141, #2226, #2368).
features.reason: Vanilla ChiseledBookShelfBlock exists in 1.20.1. PlayerDetector becomes hasNearbyAlivePlayer. Do not port 4.8's removal of death_tome_spawner and empty_canopy_bookshelf; keep both registered. Checked: 4.3 worldgen never places them, so only creative-placed blocks would otherwise be lost.

features.title: Scepter repair recipe, essence repair, Renewal enchantment, new scepter FX
features.description: Merged from scepter-repair-rework, scepter-repair-renewal, renewal-enchantment, scepter-fixes-and-sounds, the essence part of casket-and-repair-recipes, and scepter-lich-fx-client. The shapeless scepter repairs become the twilightforest:scepter_repair recipe (fixed durability per craft). essence_repair_recipe fully restores a #scepters item. The Renewal enchantment recharges an empty scepter from the inventory. Scepters stop breaking at 0 durability. Dispenser fix (#2088). New sounds (twilight_scepter.use/pearl_hit, zombie_scepter.use, life_scepter.drain) and particles (magic_effect, twilight_orb).
features.reason: Checked: 4.3 has no ScepterRepairRecipe, only vanilla shapeless repairs. The recipes are CustomRecipe over CraftingContainer. Renewal is a 1.21 data-driven enchantment, so it becomes a classic treasure Enchantment plus each scepter's inventoryTick. MAGIC_EFFECT's ColorParticleOption needs a custom ParticleOptions.
features.savegame_impact: new ids; the old shapeless scepter repair recipe ids are removed

features.title: Lich boss fight overhaul (phases, clones, minions, candles, death animation)
features.description: Merged from lich-rework, lich-boss-fight-rework and the content part of lich-boss-fight-tweaks. Adds synced attributes clone_count, max_shield_strength and minion_count, a 1.125 scale, an eyes layer and a translucent clone render type. The Lich teleports home, placing bold_stone_pillar, when it cannot path, and retargets in multiplayer. Phase 2 strafes and deflects #lich_deflects_phase_2 projectiles; phase 3 uses golden-sword melee with ANGRY_LICH particles. Baby minions on Hard, Speed III. Candle and candelabra theatrics turn ominous at fight start and relight on death. About 300 ticks of death animation end with flames swirling into the chest.
features.reason: Plain Java, but 4.3's Lich.java (858 lines) diverges from 4.8's (1,086), so expect near a rewrite. Entity#deflection and ProjectileDeflection (1.20.5) must be redone through ProjectileImpactEvent or a TFThrowable override. Adjust the eye height and passenger attachment builders. Degrades gracefully in the old tower without candles.
features.savegame_impact: new ids only (attributes, particles, tag); existing Liches load with defaults

features.title: Lich Tower revamp (jigsaw tower, graveyard yard, wings, bridges, new boss room)
features.description: Merged from lich-tower-revamp, lich-tower-jigsaw-revamp, lich-tower-rework-completion and lich-tower-rework-finish. The flagship 4.8 structure replaces TowerMainComponent. A foyer and vestibule lead into a central tower of base, slices and trim whose height comes from the terrain's geometric mean, capped by a boss room and roof. Side wings of 3x3 to 9x9 rooms (about 130 room, junction, roof and beard templates) are joined by spawner, room and end bridges, including rope bridges. There is a magic gallery. Outside: a flattened yard (BoxDensityFunction), a ruined wrought-iron fence with leashed zombies, graves (grave/ajar/open with casket_loot) and candle lights. Spawn indices: rising zombies in the yard, classic monsters inside. Progression-locked per piece. Ships with 182 NBT templates and 7 loot tables.
features.reason: Sweep estimates ranged from 80 to 150h. With the infrastructure and blocks costed separately, about 70h remain for 3,725 lines of tower code, the templates and tuning. Checks done: templates are DataVersion 3955, which 1.20.1's DFU leaves untouched; their palettes contain no post-1.20.1 vanilla blocks; 18 templates hold Items lists, mostly loot-table chests, plus candelabra 'Candles' BE data. TF block references in the templates: terrorcotta x3, coronation_carpet, sinister_spawner, rope, candelabra, wrought_iron_fence, keepsake_casket. Code references: MASON_JAR, CHISELED_CANOPY_BOOKSHELF, MAGIC_PAINTING, RISING_ZOMBIE. features.title: Traveller's Gear core: 6 armor pieces, armor material, models, base recipes
features.description: Merged from travellers-gear (both entries) and the core of travellers-gear-client. Six wearables made from tanned_leather: travellers_goggles (helmet), travellers_vest plus travellers_gloves (chest, with a merge recipe), travellers_wings and travellers_belt (legs), and travellers_boots. features.title: Traveller's Gear modifier system (registry, recipes, grindstone, broken state)
features.description: About 24 datapack modifiers (twilightforest:travellers_modifiers, of types attribute, builtin, component and transferable_component) are inserted with shaped or shapeless modifier recipes and stripped at the grindstone, which returns stored items. features.title: Wings: Double Jump, Sidestep, Gradual Glide, High Jump, Agile Ranger
features.description: Built-in High Jump. Double Jump: stronger after a slime bounce, +2 safe fall, with particles and sound. Sidestep: double-tap for a 5-block dash on a 2 s cooldown. features.title: Boots: Slimy Soles, Unrestrained, Water Walk, Straight Ahead, Step Up
